selected_evidence.summary: Source bytes were captured; cmp and matching SHA-256 hashes proved exact installed contents, mode 0755, and successful launcher execution.
Reinstallation restored deliberately altered managed files, retained an unrelated file, and succeeded again after restart.
An impossible destination returned exit 1, emitted a clear diagnostic, and was not created.
Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; no software was installed or upgraded.

Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID 643a59cc-1abc-486d-af8e-85e3d7266ca3 proved restart, and post-restart checks confirmed system health, SSH/chrony recovery, SELinux enforcing, unchanged data hashes, and the complete installer workflow.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'Usage: %s DESTINATION\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

case $0 in
    */*) script_path=$0 ;;
    *)
        script_path=$(command -v "$0") || {
            printf 'install-report: cannot locate installer\n' >&2
            exit 1
        }
        ;;
esac

base=$(
    CDPATH=
    cd -P "$(dirname "$script_path")/.." &&
    pwd
) || {
    printf 'install-report: cannot locate bundle\n' >&2
    exit 1
}

destination=$1
case $destination in
    /*|./*|../*) ;;
    *) destination=./$destination ;;
esac

if ! mkdir -p "$destination"; then
    printf 'install-report: cannot create destination: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$destination" ]; then
    printf 'install-report: destination is not a directory: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for file in summary.txt detail.txt; do
    if ! cp "$base/templates/$file" "$destination/$file"; then
        printf 'install-report: cannot install %s in %s\n' "$file" "$1" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! cp "$base/launcher" "$destination/run-report"; then
    printf 'install-report: cannot install launcher in %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! chmod +x "$destination/run-report"; then
    printf 'install-report: cannot make launcher executable in %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
ANTRIEB_INSTALLER_EOF
chown root:root bin/.install-report.new
